title: ジャパンカップにむけて

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The arena is roaring with life on the day of the Japan Cup. The seats are filled with celebrating spectators, not a vacancy to be seen.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I make my descent! Behold—this is beauty, perfected! Be amazed at my power!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: The soon-to-be Centurial Overlord faces off with her eternal nemesis, the Dark Tempest Lord… Doto.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: My path has led me to the Japan Cup, where my pride as ruler is on the line. And now, it begins!
